subject: Re: MAP & acceptance timeline — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA details
messages:
From: Kate Sullivan <kate.sullivan@finnovasys.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finnovasys.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff — SOC 2 evidence + DPA retention Qs

Hi Vanessa / Rachel,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team at Finova is aligned on moving to an evaluation with a goal to close by end of July. Before we lock dates, we need to map the security gates inside the MAP so procurement and legal can sign off. Two immediate asks from our side: 

1) SOC 2: can you provide the scope matrix (what in-scope, shared responsibilities) and the most recent Type II report delivery ETA?
2) SIG / CAIQ: we can start with a partial SIG for infra and data handling — is that OK? If so, please send the template you expect redwood to populate and a list of the items you can complete vs items we should answer.
3) DPA / retention: we need a simple table with retention tiers (30/90/365/ever) per artifact class, and whether log export is possible to our S3.

Procurement is copied for timing constraints — they requested a mutual action plan with milestones so the contract team can schedule redlines. Attached is a one-page outline of what they want.

Could you confirm owner(s) and an initial MAP draft by Monday (18 Jun)? If necessary we can stretch a week but would prefer to keep the July close target.

Thanks,
Kate
Kate Sullivan
Head of IT Vendor Ops — Finova Systems
Phone: +1 415-555-0124

Attachment: MAP-outline-procurement.pdf (pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Sullivan <kate.sullivan@finnovasys.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@finnovasys.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — SOC 2 evidence + DPA retention Qs

Hi Kate — thanks for the clear asks and the MAP outline. We're happy to support the July close target. Quick notes / commitments below and a proposed MAP cadence attached.

High-level commitments:
- SOC 2: Redwood can share a scope matrix and our latest Type II summary by 21 Jun. Full Type II report shared under NDA.
- SIG / CAIQ: we will fill infra and data handling sections and send a partially completed SIG spreadsheet by 18 Jun. We'll flag the questions we need Finova to complete.
- DPA / retention: Rachel will draft a retention tiers table showing default retention + options for contract carve-outs (30/90/365/custom) and call out export mechanisms (S3 export + event log streaming).

Next steps (MAP milestones):
1) 18 Jun — Partial SIG + MAP draft (attachment: MAP-draft-v1.docx)
2) 21 Jun — SOC 2 scope matrix + NDA for full report
3) 25 Jun — DPA retention table + procurement redline window opens
4) 02 Jul — Final responses, compliance acceptance window opens
5) 16 Jul — Contract signature target (buffer for legal)

Owners: Rachel (evidence + retention table), Marcus (billing/credits & SLA calls), Vanessa (MAP owner / escalation).

If procurement needs a different cadence, say so and we'll adapt. 

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment: MAP-draft-v1.docx (docx)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Sullivan <kate.sullivan@finnovasys.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG partial + retention table (drafts)

Hi Kate — attaching the two files we discussed: a partially completed SIG/CAIQ and a CSV export that maps artifact classes to retention tiers. Highlights: 

- SIG: infra, network controls, host hardening, and data handling sections completed. The spreadsheet flags ~12 items where we need customer input (marked "Finova action").
- Retention table: default model artifacts (inference cache) = 30 days; user-provided data = customer-controlled (can be set to 90/365/ever); logs = 90 days by default but exportable. Export: system supports S3 export and continuous event streaming; we'll include the export sample command in the final.

Two asks from our side to keep the July target: 
1) Please confirm which Finova user roles should be able to request log exports (security vs procurement).
2) If you require EU residency for any subset, let us know now to add data residency clause.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Finova_SIG_partial.xlsx, DPA-retention-table.csv
From: Kate Sullivan <kate.sullivan@finnovasys.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Hart <mike.hart@finnovasys.com>, Procurement <procurement@finnovasys.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG partial + retention table (drafts)

Thanks Rachel — this is exactly what we needed. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Finova action items: I'll assign these to our infra lead and aim to return answers within 5 business days (should hit 25 Jun).
- Log exports: security team (security@finnovasys.com) should be the only role with export permission. Procurement won't need direct exports.
- Residency: No EU residency required for this initial POC — all U.S. data.

One procurement note: they want the DPA retention table included as an exhibit to accelerate legal review. Can you provide a CSV + human-readable table to attach to the DPA?

I'll confirm the internal owners and get the SIG back by 25 Jun. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

—Kate

Kate / team — quick finance / SLA notes as you finalize the MAP: 

- SLA credits: we can offer a 10% credit for the first 6 months if a sustained P99 latency breach occurs and procurement wants that language; Marcus will draft the clause and attach to the MAP.
- Billing ramp: we recommend a 60% reserved capacity commit for initial POC month with a month-to-month flex afterwards — happy to model numbers if you share anticipated token volumes.
- DocuSign: we will prepare the DPA + exhibit (retention table) as a package. I'll circulate a DocuSign link once procurement confirms acceptance of the exhibit format.

Vanessa / Rachel — please add the SLA credit language and the DPA exhibit csv to the MAP bundle so procurement has everything in one packet.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
